priorAuditCorrections.finding: UserMapConclusion, Investigation, FieldworkAssignment, and ModelUpdate are four candidate object types handled in one internal operator workbench. They are not four pattern families.
The five actual pattern families are trigger_condition, inner_critic, repetitive_loop, contradiction_drift, and recovery_stabilizer.

A hidden internal route is not automatically a public-product defect. The review page explicitly identifies itself as an internal operator workbench. Whether an allowlisted operator must reach it through this shell is a product/operations decision that was not established by the current authority.

The prior fixed seven-delivery roadmap is withdrawn. The nine deliveries in this audit are derived from the current dependency graph and begin with the highest-severity proven live intelligence break.

The prior audit correctly identified the canonical shell mount, honest EMPTY_ORVEK_DATA_API base, genuine live readers, composition precedence, missing first-class Decision/Outcome/Goal objects, and the prohibition on inferring deployed data.

The prior audit correctly described Explore as post-reply grounding and a reviewable ModelUpdate path, but it did not identify that the proposed movement semantics are fixed prose unrelated to arbitrary conversations or that lexical evidence labels can be forced into the mixed-status gate.

CANONICAL-UNDERSTANDING-CANDIDATE-REVIEW-RESTORATION-001 is not automatically the next product task. It assumed the internal workbench belonged in the canonical user experience and ranked code availability above the proven unsafe Explore movement pathway.
